description:
A two hour practical workshop for parents and caregivers on sensory processing in autistic children, led by an occupational therapist.

Venue: Hatfield Community Hall, 1120 Burnett Street, Hatfield, Pretoria. Secure parking behind the hall.

The room has natural light, no fluorescent lights, and a separate quiet room. Step free entrance and an accessible toilet.

Tea and coffee included. Your ticket covers one adult.

This is a demo event created for a presentation.
title: Demo: Parent workshop, understanding sensory needs

description:
Join us for a relaxed day out for autistic people, their families and friends.

Venue: Pretoria National Botanical Garden, 2 Cussonia Avenue, Brummeria, Pretoria. Free parking at the main gate.

There will be a quiet tent with soft lighting and beanbags, sensory play for the children and plenty of shade. The paths are paved and wheelchair accessible.

Bring your own picnic. Water is provided.

This is a demo event created for a presentation.
title: Demo: Autism Family Picnic 2026

description:
A short community walk to mark World Autism Awareness Day, followed by tea and a talk from autistic self advocates.

Venue: Union Buildings gardens, Government Avenue, Arcadia, Pretoria. Meet at the lower gardens entrance.

The route is 2 km on paved paths and suitable for wheelchairs and prams. A quiet area was set up near the start.

This is a demo event created for a presentation.
title: Demo: World Autism Awareness Day walk
